title: Scrape Save omits naming, delays confirmation, and opens an unusable filing browser
severity: S2: central capture workflow is confusing and slow; users cannot name the Source at save time
preconditions: Use the installed development extension in Chrome on a content page with a captured article; sign in and select an organization.
reproduction: Open Scrape, capture the page, click Save.
Observe that no editable Source name or destination choice appears before the write.
After Saved, inspect the automatic filing panel: Library selector, broad eight-type browse list, and a second File action.
Try to scroll the Projects list to a project beyond the first visible rows; the list does not scroll to it.
Observe the additional wait between the Source landing and the Saved state.
expected: A compact save dialog immediately offers a prefilled editable name and a fast optional destination choice; one primary Save lands the named Source with selected associations and shows confirmation promptly. Project search and scrolling reach every result. Full browsing and Library loading occur only on request.
actual: The compact pre-save form and prompt landing are implemented. Valid native-5 confirmed a named Source and persisted Project association. Valid native-6 on the imported CI development artifact source af13274c35ee16e28014e90b1e50c73ad433d348 / version 0.2.457 confirmed the editable Name, full captured URL displayed as non-input text, one-click Projects results, visible list scrolling, keyboard project selection, and Tab/Shift+Tab focus wrap. Source 39378ff2-1a20-4999-9f53-d9735bc04bbc (EXT-D-0187 Native Save 6 2026-10-10) reopened with Saved state, full URL, and captured content; Project 4484ab9c-bb04-4adc-a894-df2e9f18960f showed it among 3 attached Sources after refresh. Later shared-main cleanup commits da2e314b0 and 21f07fb92 were not in this artifact. Hosted attempt 38016707554 failed in the harness before the UI callback because the driver compared the frozen artifact SHA with the workflow checkout SHA; no member sign-in, Source query/write, or cleanup action occurred. This is not product evidence. Duplicate, no-destination, refusal/retry, additional destination/Library/File elsewhere paths, and guest/member role coverage remain unverified. EXT-D-0187 remains in-fix. Guarded hosted member run 38024258868 used the exact unpublished CI development artifact from source dc249bf913beb31be5498093af1e080d9f39661a (CI 38023616657, artifact 11659416379, v0.2.458). It verified member/non-admin identity and selected organization; captured an owned article; entered a custom Source name through trusted keyboard input; selected the one exact run-owned Project candidate; observed Saved; independently read the persisted Source row and the selected Project association; and verified source, association and Project fixture cleanup. A fresh independent review accepts only these bounded observations. The driver did not reopen the saved Source UI or read its saved content, so that requirement and full T04/T29 closure remain open; duplicate, no-destination, refusal/retry, multiple destinations/Library, timing and guest/admin coverage also remain unverified.
evidence: User-provided Scrape and filing screenshots plus report that the Projects list does not scroll (2026-10-09, captured in task)

A separate initial-organization hydration race remounted/dismissed the Save form and caused cumulative 10-second test waits; the builder repaired hydration/switch handling and the focused suite now passes.
